title: Stephane B Possible NDE 3366
content: It was an unbearable pain, level 12/10. I sat on passenger seat with a water ring below my bums to somewhat lower the pain. I was cold and all my body shook. An extreme weariness overwhelmed me, something I had never known, even at illness times. I closed my eyes to try to sleep and at a moment, I felt I was going somewhere else. I saw myself in a heavenly landscape, there was clay ground, a beautiful blue sky, grass, slight and tepid breeze, and there was an olive tree next to me. My grandfather, dead since 1988, was sitting there, quietly playing the lute. He told me, sit down there dear Steph, you'll see we're alright there. I asked him where we were, he answered that I knew it, I was in Heaven but I should not worry. I felt huge pleasure emotion pervade me, I felt happy and free and about to cry for joy. I had tears in my eyes for so much beauty and for seeing my grandfather. Then, deceased people came to visit me and they called my name, saying that I should come because you felt good there and I belonged there. I belonged among them; they outstretched their arms towards me. I saw dozens of dead family members. There were other people I did not know, but who also outstretched their arms to me. I felt like I would cry for joy, saying to myself that death was so beautiful. I wanted to die now, driven by joy and happiness. Pain had disappeared; I felt no pain at all then. I stammered out to my girlfriend, they are all there. She woke me up then, but it was hard for me to get out from sleepiness.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt he was 'going somewhere else' after closing his eyes.

arrival.other_being_detail: Dozens of dead family members; also other unknown people who outstretched their arms toward him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Clay ground; grass; slight/tepid breeze; olive tree; 'heavenly landscape' and 'beautiful blue sky'.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Girlfriend woke him up from sleepiness.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe pain with shaking, cold, and extreme weariness; fell into sleepiness in a car passenger seat.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pain cessation during the experience; strong sense of belonging; invitation by deceased to come with them.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Closed eyes/sleepiness, felt going elsewhere, immediate arrival in heavenly landscape with deceased grandfather and many deceased people; then awakened by girlfriend.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Grandfather was 'quietly playing the lute' in the heavenly landscape.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “sit down there dear Steph, you'll see we're alright there.” “I was in Heaven but I should not worry.” “I belonged there.” “death was so beautiful.” “they are all there.”
